title: Deathtrap Dungeon: the whole quest

source.note: Zone membership of passages follows docs/TRIAL_CANON_STATUS.md; zone exits and their flags are the legacy zones' real exits.

route_note: A run's order of play: the legacy adaptation's zone graph (see 'exits'). Gems may be taken in any order that the exits allow; Igbut (dd_igbut) checks all three.

emerald.how: an idol's eye, after the Flying Guardians

sapphire.how: a box with an iron key

diamond.how: a later hall route (book); the legacy places it in the inner vault; a false diamond waits in dd_vaults (218)

final_use.how: Igbut checks all three, then the three-position lock

knight.known_fate: later recognized as a petrified statue

elf.known_fate: mortally wounded after Boa Constrictor; gives diamond clue if rescued

throm.start: one of the two Barbarian contestants; one Barbarian enters before the player

black_clad_assassin.note: A later Ninja is canonical, but this extraction does not prove they are the same individual.

second_barbarian.note: Do not automatically map every later generic 'Barbarian' reference to Throm without passage-context verification.

encounters.name: Flying Guardians
encounters.translation: Two small sequential or multi-target Duel Master encounters

encounters.name: Cave Trolls
encounters.translation: John duels one while Throm visibly handles the other

encounters.name: Mirror Demon
encounters.translation: Only launch Duel Master if player chooses direct combat

encounters.name: Bloodbeast
encounters.translation: Multi-slot Duel Master boss with pre-battle advantage if weakness learned

encounters.name: Troglodytes
encounters.translation: Run of the Arrow and river escape stay traversal; direct fight can use representative formation encounter

encounters.name: Poison Ivy
encounters.translation: Dialogue/payment/escape; optional Duel Master only on attack

encounters.name: Igbut gem lock
encounters.translation: Use Duel Master visual language but preserve three gems / positional feedback

zones.name: Crystal Entrance
zones.role: Trial gate and crystal entrance: the contestants, Sukumvit's aid box, the first corridor
items: aid box (2 gold pieces, Sukumvit's note)

zones.name: Footprint Fork
zones.role: First fork: the painted arrow, the footprints, the east loop that reconnects
items: draught to the service tunnels once the east loop is walked

zones.name: Footprint Galleries
zones.role: Footprint Galleries: branching tracks, the old man's riddle, the petrified Knight

zones.name: Throm's Pit
zones.role: Throm's Pit: the Barbarian joins; lower him, be lowered, jump or climb alone (ally or betray)

zones.name: Lower Route
zones.role: Lower Route: the books, the Cave Troll ambush with Throm, the bone ring

zones.name: Trialmaster Complex
zones.role: Dwarf Trialmaster complex: the lock-in, the dice and cobra tests, Throm's forced duel, the concealed way

zones.name: Idol Cavern
zones.role: Idol Cavern: the Flying Guardians, the emerald eye, the false eye

zones.name: Drowned Grotto
zones.role: Drowned Grotto: the Boa, the dying Elf, her bread and charm, the diamond clue

zones.name: Sapphire Vaults
zones.role: Sapphire Vaults: the iron key and sapphire, the false diamond that wounds and seals the inner vault

zones.name: Inner Vault
zones.role: Inner Vault: the true diamond (the legacy puts it here; the book's route is the later hall, 269 and 330)

zones.name: Service Tunnels
zones.role: Service Tunnels: the prisoner, Poison Ivy's toll, the Basket man's lift; the way back to the fork once the east loop was walked

zones.name: Mirror Gallery
zones.role: Mirror Gallery: smash the mirrors or fight the demon; the shard teaches Light

zones.name: Bloodbeast Lair
zones.role: Bloodbeast Lair: the herbs or the prisoner's knowledge ban Vine from its Ward

zones.name: Grub Tunnels
zones.role: Grub Tunnels: the boulder, the trapped chest

zones.name: Troglodyte Cavern
zones.role: Troglodyte Cavern: the rite, the run of the arrow, or the champion; the reed back to the grotto

zones.name: Manticore Gate
zones.role: Manticore Gate: the last major creature, a boss; winning leads on to Igbut

zones.name: Igbut's Door
zones.role: Igbut's door: the gem check, the three-position lock, the final crossbow trap, daylight
items: the three gems are checked and, on a wrong order, scattered

exits.requires: the three gems in the right order (the victory door)

1.beat: Crystal-lit entrance tunnel; six boxes including one bearing the contestant's name.
1.adaptation: Trial Gate / first physical corridor; optional aid box.

270.beat: Named box provides two gold pieces and Sukumvit's warning that several items will be needed.
270.adaptation: Optional aid pickup and first explicit hint that the dungeon is an item-dependent puzzle.

66.beat: First major junction: white arrow points west; several footprints went west and one east.
66.adaptation: Physical fork with visible tracks and painted arrow.

119.beat: Eastern branch loops toward the soft obstruction / opening route.
119.adaptation: Short exploratory loop demonstrating that routes can reconnect.

293.beat: Three sets of footprints divide: two west, one north.
293.adaptation: Second footprint fork; rivals function as moving breadcrumbs.

382.beat: Old man's statue riddle; the player recognizes the petrified Knight who entered the Trial first.
382.adaptation: Puzzle room and first concrete evidence of a rival's fate.

154.beat: Player catches up with the Barbarian and travels west with him.
154.adaptation: Throm physically joins John as a temporary companion.

22.beat: Uneasy temporary alliance with the Barbarian; both know only one contestant may win; they reach a deep pit.
22.adaptation: Companion choice at a physical pit; preserve mistrust and cooperation.

184.beat: The Barbarian identifies himself as Throm. His distrust is visible while the player lowers him by rope.

194.beat: Two leather-bound books; Throm is contemptuous of reading and urges haste.
194.adaptation: Walkable alcove where companion behaviour communicates personality.

138.beat: Black book contains an unknown potion; Throm refuses it and distrusts the unknown.
138.adaptation: Item experimentation with Throm reacting in-world.

169.beat: Throm hears approaching footsteps first; two Cave Trolls arrive and each adventurer takes one.
169.adaptation: Parallel encounter: Throm visibly occupies one troll while John enters a Duel Master battle with the other.

288.beat: Throm has killed his troll but is wounded. A druidic bone ring is found; he refuses to touch it and advises against it.
288.adaptation: Companion commentary changes how a risky pickup feels without removing player agency.

60.beat: Dwarf Trialmaster locks John and Throm in a chamber and says only one may continue. Throm proposes attacking him.
60.adaptation: Major social/puzzle set-piece; Dwarf is controller, not a generic monster.

365.beat: John persuades Throm to accept the Trialmaster's procedure; the Dwarf takes John through a secret door and begins a dice-probability test.
365.adaptation: Interactive Trialmaster mini-test rather than Duel Master combat.

302.beat: The Dwarf later sends in a wounded, delirious Throm. The cobra has bitten him. John protests but must defend himself.
302.adaptation: Mandatory tragic Duel Master encounter; Throm is not a villain.

379.beat: After Throm dies, John hates the Dwarf. The Dwarf keeps John at crossbow point and reveals the concealed way onward.
379.adaptation: Post-battle scene must preserve emotional consequence and the Dwarf's control.

281.beat: After rescuing the Elf from a Boa Constrictor, she is dying; she reveals that gems unlock the final door and identifies diamond as one required gem.
281.adaptation: Character death and crucial clue; her belongings become physical pickups.

37.beat: Large idol cavern with fist-sized jewelled eyes and two stuffed bird-like guardians.

240.beat: After the Flying Guardians are defeated, the emerald eye can be removed.
240.adaptation: Emerald acquired; tempting second eye remains dangerous.

162.beat: A box contains an iron key and a large sapphire.

218.beat: A room appears to contain a diamond beside a fallen warrior, but entering can be a lethal trap.

269.beat: A later hall route allows the player to leave carrying the real diamond.

364.beat: After the Manticore, Igbut the Gnome appears as final Trialmaster and checks for the three required gems.
364.adaptation: Final checkpoint NPC; no generic battle unless player attacks.

62.beat: Final lock has three gem positions. Wrong arrangements cause injury; Igbut gives aggregate positional feedback and allows retries.
62.adaptation: Preserve as a three-position Duel-Master-like logic lock rather than replacing it with combat.

241.beat: After the final lock route, Igbut is killed by a final Sukumvit crossbow trap and John reaches daylight.

399.beat: The Elf's bread contains healing herbs; the player packs away the mirror and charm and continues north.

400.beat: Victory: the surviving contestant emerges to Fang and is acclaimed as Champion.
400.adaptation: Dungeon completion / return to wider game.
